structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

law.catch_line: Property and liabilities of Eastern Virginia Medical School
law.text: All real estate and personal property in the name of the corporate body designated "Eastern Virginia Medical School" transferred to, known and taken as standing in the name of, and under the control of the University is the property of the Commonwealth. The University is vested with all rights, duties, contracts, and agreements and is responsible and liable for all the liabilities and obligations of Eastern Virginia Medical School.
